sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Dainty Bracelet Combo Set – Minimalist Link Chain & Elegant Leaf Motif Duo
sourceNotes.rawContent: Blossom with style in this chic gold-toned bracelet duo. Combining a timeless link chain with a modern leaf-motif strand, this high-fashion set is perfect for effortless layering. To maintain its radiant luster, keep these pieces dry and store safely in a dry place after every wear.
